commentary_title: Uptick in tonnage demand boosts freight rates
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles index fell to 96.2 points in week 40 after a continuous rise for the past three weeks. Vessel speeds in the West seem to be declining while speeds in the East have increased. | The week started off slow, but an uptick in market activity by mid-week increased tonnage demand, especially in the UKC and Med regions, boosting freight rates. | Though the %laden weakened in the past week, increased market activity will have more laden vessels moving out of the Med next week. Freight rates are likely to remain supported.
